name: SeaCache
plain: TeaCache-like accumulation, but the change metric is computed after a sigma-dependent spectral filter, so frequency bands the current noise level hides don't count. No polynomial calibration is needed in this pack. H3 gets a separate runtime with video and audio accumulators.
math:
Filter per axis: g(f) = a·S/(a²S+b²+ε), S = 1/(|f|^p+ε), a=1−σ', b=σ', σ' = normalised flow sigma. Product over dims, normalised to mean 1, applied through full complex FFT.
A += mean|F(m)−F(m_prev)|/max(mean|F(m_prev)|,1e-16), run if A≥τ; per CFG branch.
H3: max(A_video, A_audio)<τ skips; audio unfiltered per the docstring; stride 4.
